name: Jane Hume by leave—I move amendments (1) to (16) on sheet TW114 together: (1) Schedule 1, item 1, page 3 (line 15), omit "1 July 2019", substitute "1 November 2019". (3) Schedule 1, item 1, page 5 (after line 29), at the end of subsection 68AAC(4), add: ; or (e) a member to whom the dangerous occupation exception applies (see section 68AAF).
